title: Rung: special relativity from finite signal speed

statements.text: Once the conserved redistribution propagates at a finite invariant speed $c_t$, Galilean comparison between observers fails, and the Lorentz transformations are the admissible comparison structure that keeps the propagation boundary invariant.

sources.quote: Lorentz covariance therefore appears because lawful observer comparison can no longer preserve both Galilean simultaneity and invariant finite signalling simultaneously.
This section is intentionally standard. The novelty does not lie in a new Lorentz transformation.
